description: This Java class 'XYData' models a collection of 3D data points with methods to add, set, retrieve, and save data points, primarily used for managing XY coordinate data associated with some form of sensor or logging data.

classes.name: XYData
classes.description: Represents a dataset of XY points with associated Y-axis data, with methods to manipulate and serialize the data.

methods.name: XYData
methods.description: Constructor initializing the XYData object and clearing previous data.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves the Z-value for a given X and Y coordinate.

methods.name: getMaxXValue
methods.description: Returns the maximum X value in the data set.

methods.name: getMinXValue
methods.description: Returns the minimum X value in the data set.

methods.name: getMaxYValue
methods.description: Returns the maximum Y value in the data set.

methods.name: getMinYValue
methods.description: Returns the minimum Y value in the data set.

methods.name: addPoint
methods.description: Adds a new point to the dataset using RPM, key, and value.

methods.name: addPoint
methods.description: Adds a new 3D point (Point3D) to the dataset.

methods.name: setPoint
methods.description: Sets a specific point's value in the dataset.

methods.name: getYdata
methods.description: Retrieves or creates YAxisData for a given 3D point.

methods.name: getXSet
methods.description: Returns the set of X coordinates present in the dataset.

methods.name: getYAxis
methods.description: Retrieves or creates YAxisData for a specific X coordinate.

methods.name: findYAxis
methods.description: Finds the YAxisData closest to a given X coordinate.

methods.name: findXfromSet
methods.description: Finds the closest X value from the set to a given X coordinate.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Resets all data and min/max values.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the data.

methods.name: saveToFile
methods.description: Saves the dataset to a file with a name based on the date.

methods.name: fill
methods.description: Fills the dataset with uniformly distributed points within specified ranges.
